Tenancy: Ask agent Let type: Long term Furnish type: Furnished Council Tax: Ask agent PROPERTY TYPE Apartment BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 SIZE 892 sq ft 83 sq m No floorplan +20 Key features Two bedroomFurnished892sqft with 140sqft balconyResidents club with concierge servicePrivate cinemas with food and drink facilitiesSwimming pool with adjoining sun terraceFully equipped gymGreat transport links Description Luxury two bedroom apartment located in Cassini Tower, White City Living. Situated on the 10th floor, this apartment boasts just under 900sqft internally with a 140sqft private wrap around balcony. White City Living is the highly-anticipated next chapter of the White City W12 regeneration area, offering over 1,400 new homes including suites, apartments, penthouses and duplexes. Set among eight acres of green open spaces, all within 15 minutes of central London. The development includes a modern concierge as well as a fully equipped gym. White City Living is rising up from a whole new London landscape that has nature at its forefront. It's West London's brightest new neighbourhood, an area of wide-open spacious parkland and secluded gardens with refurbished railway arches which will provide connection to Westfield as well as new bars and boutique shops, creating a humble yet exciting new place to live.
